remarks: Classic center hall Colonial with thoughtful updates and wonderful natural light throughout. Renovated kitchen with Sub-Zero and Wolf appliances features a cheerful breakfast nook overlooking the yard. A spacious living room with wood-burning fireplace, bright family room, and formal dining room complete the first floor. Well-proportioned bedrooms provide comfortable living, while the walk-up attic presents exceptional opportunity for future expansion. Renovated lower level includes a playroom, laundry room, and flexible office or guest bedroom space. Additional highlights include natural gas heat and hot water, on-demand generator, and a two-car garage with EV charger. Large fenced yard and expansive patio create a wonderful space for entertaining, relaxing, and play. Ideally located within easy walking distance to Metro-North Railroad and the shops and restaurants at Darien Commons. A rare opportunity to enjoy comfort, style, and convenience in one exceptional Darien home.
